panels.description: Ada places the photographs on Leona's table. Leave upper-left clear.
Leona meets Ada's eyes across the photographs. Leave upper area for dialogue.
Ada grips the table edge, holding herself upright. Leave upper-left clear.
Leona touches the dark band but leaves it on the table. Keep the band visible and reserve upper space.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: Did you know where I was?

items.speaker: LEONA
items.text: I made the safer choice. It hurt you anyway.
